instruction: How to add grace mode in VCL
output: echo 'sub vcl_hit { if (obj.ttl >= 0s) { return (deliver); } if (obj.ttl + obj.grace > 0s && std.healthy(req.backend_hint)) { return (deliver); } return (fetch); } sub vcl_backend_response { set beresp.grace = 24h; }' > /etc/varnish/grace.vcl

How to add a director in VCL for load balancing
output: echo 'backend server1 { .host = "10.0.0.1"; .port = "80"; } backend server2 { .host = "10.0.0.2"; .port = "80"; } directors round-robin directors_round_robin { { .backend = server1; } { .backend = server2; } } sub vcl_recv { set req.backend_hint = directors_round_robin.backend(); }' > /etc/varnish/director.vcl
